rationale: Tests recognition of the primary indications for ECT, a core PS13.1 objective. Placed after the indications content block before the micro_quiz to consolidate learning without duplication.
Tests application of procedural knowledge — specifically the essential role of succinylcholine and general anaesthesia in the modified ECT protocol, a critical safety distinction from unmodified ECT.

Targets the most clinically harmful ECT misconception — memory effects — requiring learners to discriminate transient post-treatment memory disturbance from permanent brain damage. Placed after the misconceptions block for immediate consolidation.
